label: Modality
text: PL.O.A1.2 Modality. Possible worlds as a device; de re and de dicto; essentialism. Rule: a necessity claim must say which type it is: logical, metaphysical or nomological. Modal systems K, T, S4 and S5 as calculi are MA.O.A1; which one models metaphysical necessity is PL.O.A1.2.

warrant.standard: Valid in a stated modal system; intuitions reconciled
